<!-- @format -->

Place your own portrait and food photography in this folder. Images uploaded in Admin are stored persistently in `data/uploads/` and served from `/uploads/`.

The starter dish photos in this folder are automatically added to the portfolio and listed in Admin on first startup. You can edit or remove them there; removed starter dishes stay removed.

When editing a dish in Admin, choose whether its photo should fill and crop to the frame or show the full image. Admin also lets you choose any saved dish as the signature dish and choose which dish supplies the “Elements on the Plate” image and ingredient details. Deleting a selected dish automatically assigns the next available dish. Profile phone numbers saved in Admin appear as a tap-to-call link on the public portfolio.
